sentences.l2: 病気で、からだのなかの大切なところがうごかなくなった人がいます。
sentences.l1: There are people whose important part inside the body has stopped working because of illness.

sentences.l2: ほかの人が、じぶんの臓器をあげることを、提供といいます。
sentences.l1: When another person gives their own organ, it is called donation.

sentences.l2: 医者は手術をして、その臓器を病気の人のからだに入れます。
sentences.l1: Doctors perform surgery and put that organ into the body of the sick person.

sentences.l2: これが移植で、大切な医療です。
sentences.l1: This is transplantation, and it is important medical care.
